ns2:section.sectionText: Reading & Writing Autobiography, 3 hours. Reading and writing autobiography will offer freshman time to read autobiographies/memoirs of the lives of others (if possible drawing upon the published works of Pioneers in their field) as they begin a new phase of their own lives. This course will offer an opportunity to read, write and learn from the lives of others. First year Discovery Program Course. Registeration restricted to freshman. Students should only enroll in one Discovery course.
